info.name: BevPro Gateway - SIMS SAP Integration
info.description:
Test requests for the SIMS ↔ SAP PI integration through the BevPro API Gateway.

| Direction | Gateway path | Upstream |
|---|---|---|
| SIMS → SAP | `/sap-pi-uat/XISOAPAdapter/MessageServlet` | SAP PI QAS `qbx.thainamthip.co.th:8100` |
| SAP → SIMS | `/sims-uat/api/v1/integrations/sap/service-orders` | SIMS UAT |

### Setup
Set the **Current value** of `sapPassword` and `simsPassword` in the collection variables. Do not store passwords in Initial value.

### Notes
- SIMS → SAP: the caller IP must be in the gateway allow list, otherwise the gateway returns 403.
- `SVC_NAV_01` is shared with D365 F&O. Stop after a 401 — repeated failed logins lock the account.
- Work Order Update creates a message in SAP PI. Submit Service Order writes to SIMS UAT.

item.description: Outbound messages from SIMS to SAP PI (interface `WorkOrderUpdate_Out`).

request.description:
